b.description: The second operand; `SparseTensor` or `Tensor`. At least one operand must be sparse.

threshold.description: A 0-D `Tensor`. The magnitude threshold that determines if an output value/index pair takes space. Its dtype should match that of the values if they are real; if the latter are complex64/complex128, then the dtype should be float32/float64, correspondingly.

output.description: A `SparseTensor` or a `Tensor`, representing the sum.
